findings.detail: Official Mini GPIO image places SPI0_CS1_M0 on pin 15 / GPIO1_D3. Retained schematic and pinned SDK spi0m0_cs1 assign GPIO1_D2 / physical pin 14. Diagram uses the corroborated pin 14 assignment; neither ShieldSigner revision uses a second SPI CS.
LCD_3V3 has four component endpoints including TP803, not three.

remaining: Confirm live GPIO chip identities, device-tree muxes and SPI timing on the final image.
Physical voltage/continuity, module revision and optional BL_E PWM response remain bench checks.
